# AI Career School

> The first Arabic-language online academy for AI-powered content creation. Based in Cairo, Egypt. Over 1,200 students across the MENA region.

## Courses

- [AI Content Creation](https://www.aicareerschool.com/ai-content): Learn AI image, video, UGC, and commercial production using Kling, Veo, Runway, ElevenLabs, and Midjourney. 10 phases, 9+ hours. Price: 1,200 EGP. Language: Arabic.
- [Web Creation with AI](https://www.aicareerschool.com/web-creation): Build professional 3D websites, e-commerce stores, and learn SEO using AI tools. 5 phases. Price: 1,200 EGP. Language: Arabic.
- [AI for Real Estate](https://www.aicareerschool.com/real-estate): AI-powered real estate photography, video tours, and interior design visualization. Price: 1,500 EGP. Language: Arabic.

## Blog

- [AI Content Creation: Complete Beginner's Guide (2026)](https://www.aicareerschool.com/blog/ai-content-creation-beginners-guide): Step-by-step guide to AI content creation with free tools for images, video, and voice, a full worked example, and a 30-day starter plan.
- [Earning Online with AI in Egypt (2026)](https://www.aicareerschool.com/blog/earn-online-with-ai-egypt-2026): Practical freelancing guide for Egypt covering in-demand AI services, platforms, withdrawing money, taxes, and a 60-day plan to the first client.
- [Is an AI Course Worth It in 2026? + Top 7 Courses](https://www.aicareerschool.com/blog/ai-course-worth-it-2026): Honest breakdown of when an AI course is worth paying for, red flags to avoid, and a comparison of 7 free and paid AI courses.
- [How to Earn from AI in 2026](https://www.aicareerschool.com/blog/earn-from-ai-2026): Practical guide to 7 beginner-friendly ways to generate real income using AI tools without coding experience.
- [Top 10 AI Tools for Video & Images in 2026](https://www.aicareerschool.com/blog/best-ai-tools-video-images-2026): Comprehensive comparison of the best AI tools including Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Gemini Omni, Midjourney, and ElevenLabs with pricing and use cases.
- [Build a Professional Website with AI Without Code in 2026](https://www.aicareerschool.com/blog/build-website-ai-no-code-2026): Step-by-step tutorial on building professional websites and e-commerce stores using AI builders like Framer and Wix with SEO optimization.
